# Optica Egypt Local Section

> Official digital platform of the Optica Egypt Local Section, connecting Egyptian students, researchers, faculty, and engineers to the global optics and photonics community.

Optica approved the charter of the Optica Egypt Local Section on 10 September 2026. The section operates as a chartered volunteer local section of Optica, legally and operationally distinct from Optica Global corporate headquarters in Washington, D.C.

## Core Information
- Name: Optica Egypt Local Section
- Parent Organization: Optica (Washington, D.C., USA)
- Charter Approval Date: 10 September 2026
- Chartered Student Chapters in Egypt: 1 (The American University in Cairo Optica Student Chapter, currently undergoing reactivation)
- Official Website: https://optica-egypt.com/
- Contact: info@optica-egypt.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/optica-egypt-section
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/optica.egypt.section

## Canonical Sitemap (Strict English-Only Architecture)
- [Home](https://optica-egypt.com/): Institutional overview, active updates, featured initiatives, and research domains.
- [About](https://optica-egypt.com/about): Charter record, governance overview, leadership preview, partnership models, and press boilerplate.
- [Governance](https://optica-egypt.com/governance): Optica Local Section bylaws, constitutional executive seats, charter verification, and annual reporting scope.
- [Leadership](https://optica-egypt.com/leadership): Full 16-member Founding Executive Committee, Operational Committee, and Faculty Advisors roster (`/leadership/[id]`).
- [Partners](https://optica-egypt.com/partners): Collaboration frameworks, confirmed institutional partnerships, and partner proposal intake.
- [Chapters](https://optica-egypt.com/chapters): Interactive Egypt map, reactivating AUC chapter (`/chapters/auc`), and national charter checklist.
- [Fellowships](https://optica-egypt.com/fellowships): Fellowship advisories, conference travel grants, and funding directories.
- [Outreach](https://optica-egypt.com/outreach): Public science outreach demonstrations and campus optics engagement tracks.
- [Volunteer](https://optica-egypt.com/volunteer): Standing working committees and Postgres-backed committee volunteer application.
- [Projects](https://optica-egypt.com/projects): Open-source photonics PDA working group, training roadmaps, thesis concepts, and campus outreach (`/projects/[slug]`).
- [Events](https://optica-egypt.com/events): Scheduled seminars, workshops, and Visiting Lecturer sessions.
- [Open-Source Photonics](https://optica-egypt.com/open-source): Open-source PDA working group tracks and license-free photonic software index.
- [Resources](https://optica-egypt.com/resources): Free Python photonics software, domestic Egyptian research grants (ITIDA, ASRT, STDF), journals, and Optica membership cohorts.
- [Updates](https://optica-egypt.com/updates): Verified announcements, confirmed events, technical articles, and media records (`/updates/[slug]`).
- [News](https://optica-egypt.com/news): Official section announcements and governance notices.
- [Blogs](https://optica-egypt.com/blogs): Technical write-ups and simulation tutorials.
- [Press](https://optica-egypt.com/press): Official boilerplate, brand assets, typography, and media inquiry desk.
- [Gallery](https://optica-egypt.com/gallery): Verified photographic archive of section events.
- [Join](https://optica-egypt.com/join): Two-step Global Optica and Local Section intake backed by Postgres (`/api/recruitment` and `/api/submissions`), plus official social channels.
